channel.title: Notice Board weekly: Klickitat County
channel.description: Once a week: what is open for comment and coming up for a decision in Klickitat County. Not an official notice.

item.title: Klickitat County notices, week of November 2: 1 open for comment, 5 meetings coming up
item.description:
What is open for comment and coming up in Klickitat County, from the notices printed in the county papers and the agencies' own postings. Dates are as printed. This is a guide, not the official notice: each link opens the card, which links the notice itself.

Open for comment

  • Comments close Tuesday, November 17 · WA Department of Ecology
    Public Hearings and comment period on state shoreline rules

Hearings and meetings, through Tuesday, November 17

  • Tuesday, November 3 · Port of Klickitat Commissioners
    2027 budget hearing and amendment of the comprehensive scheme
  • Wednesday, November 4 · Klickitat County Lodging Tax Advisory Committee
    Lodging Tax Advisory Committee meeting
  • Monday, November 9, 7:00 pm · Klickitat County Fire District #5
    Meeting to consider and approve the 2027 Budget and Levy
  • Wednesday, November 11, 5:30 pm · Central Klickitat County Park and Recreation District
    Hearing to consider the 2027 budget (new)
  • Wednesday, November 11, 7:00 pm · Klickitat County Rural 7 Fire & Rescue
    Meeting to review and approve the 2027 Budget (new)

Bids, contracts and board seats

  • Bids due Wednesday, December 9 · Klickitat County Rural 7 Fire & Rescue
    Sealed bids on surplus property

Elections

  • Election day, Tuesday, November 3 · Skamania and Klickitat county auditors
    Ballot measures, November 3, 2026 General Election
  • Election day, Tuesday, November 3 · Klickitat County Auditor
    General Election, November 3, 2026

On the horizon

  • Not scheduled yet · White Salmon Planning Commission
    The Center Market application at 211 N Main, waiting for a new hearing
  • Not scheduled yet · Klickitat County Commissioners
    The county budget and property-tax levies for 2027

See the whole Notice Board, or pick your town there to see only what applies where you live.
